verdict.rationale: Lago's own llms.txt calls it "the open-source, real-time monetization platform", and its public GitHub repo (getlago/lago) supports local checkouts and self-hosting via Docker, so the source is readable. The specific license is not named in any first-party evidence; AGPL appears only inside a community question, which is not affirmative support. missing for 10: first-party documentation naming the license (e.g., AGPL text or a LICENSE file citation), confirmation that the full product source rather than a subset is published, independent hands-on corroboration of reading or building the source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
